items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: Hugh Rankin, I remember, I heard of him, yeah. ... Supposed to be a bass player, but I don't know.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah, they had a lot of guys. Yeah, you wouldn't know, you wouldn't know. No, no, yeah. Yeah, well like, did you know that there was a musician here named Hugh Rankin? Hughie Rankin? No.
Hugh Rankin, I remember, I heard of him, yeah. Yeah, you know what he played? No, I don't remember. Supposed to be a bass player, but I don't know.

Well there's so many of them. Did you ever hear of Payton that had a band? Payton? Yeah, Billy Payton, Henry Payton? Yeah. He had Hughie Rankin on bass, I suppose. Yeah. And he had Charlie McCurdy at one time, I heard. Yeah. He's from uptown. I guess, I don't know. He played the accordion. Yeah. Did you know Jim Gibson? Gibson, Jim Gibson. He was a guitar player. Yeah, he was a guitar player. That's an old guitar player. Yeah.
